title: Vertices
body:
The things a [[Graph]] connects. A graph is a set of vertices $V$ plus a set of edges $E$
joining pairs of them. The **degree** of a vertex is how many edges touch it; in a
[[Directed Graph]] that splits into in-degree and out-degree.

Also called nodes, which is the same word used for the elements of a [[Linked List]] or a
[[Tree]], since both are special cases of a graph.
